description: Resolve a place the user mentions (station, borough, neighbourhood, postcode, street) to ids. Station lookup forgives spelling (Kings Cross, St James Park, Elephant and Castle) and knows London codes and nicknames (KX, TCR, LST, E&C, ally pally). Returns stations (osm:…, with TfL modes, lines and zone; twin stations such as Hammersmith are listed apart) for find_areas.near_stations, local authorities (uk:lad:…; London's boroughs) for find_areas.boroughs, areas (with ladId) and addresses for get_area_overview and assess_listing, and venues (a pool, gym or sports centre by name, with latitude/longitude to pin as a place). best is the likeliest meaning: a venue named exactly so, then a town, city or council named exactly so above a stop that only shares the name; 'Liverpool St' is the station. query is an alias of q.

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.

call_id.title: Call Id

good.title: Good

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

q.title: Q

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried. Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.
